title: Husuni Kubwa is built at Kilwa
summary: The Husuni Kubwa palace at Kilwa Kisiwani was built in the early fourteenth century. Its surviving structures include an octagonal bathing pool within a substantial coastal architectural complex.

claims.text: The Husuni Kubwa palace at Kilwa Kisiwani was built in the early fourteenth century. Its surviving structures include an octagonal bathing pool within a substantial coastal architectural complex.

The palace offers a closer view of the wealth and building practices associated with a Swahili trading city. It belongs within Kilwa’s longer history rather than representing the beginning of the settlement.
